schema_name: ParkinSense Canonical Gait Feature Schema (290 Contract)
discrepancy_explanation: The discrepancy between 288 pose-derived statistical features and 290 production input columns is exactly the two video acquisition metadata columns: fps (frames per second) and num_frames (total analyzed frames). Legacy baseline pd_detector.pkl ingested all 290 columns, whereas gait-biomechanics-pure models exclude fps and num_frames to prevent metadata-driven confounding across datasets.
missing_value_policy: Zero missing values permitted. All values must be finite float64. Samples with NaN or Inf are rejected.

pipeline_semantic_comparison.MediaPipe: Computes 33 3D world landmarks from single-camera video, infers 24 joint relative rotation matrices via geometric inverse kinematics, and converts to 72 axis-angle channels.
pipeline_semantic_comparison.HMR2_4DHumans: Full-body SMPL mesh optimization directly regressing 3D rotation matrices for the SMPL skeleton, then converted to 72 axis-angle channels.
pipeline_semantic_comparison.Compatibility_finding: While both pipelines map onto the identical 290-dimensional format (72 axis-angle channels x 4 statistics + 2 metadata), cross-domain absolute magnitudes differ due to monocular depth ambiguities in MediaPipe vs mesh prior in HMR2. Feature normalization or domain-consistent training is required.

columns.name: fps
columns.description: Effective acquisition frame rate of the video recording.
columns.missing_value_behavior: Must be positive and finite. Default fallback: 30.0 if unreadable.

columns.name: num_frames
columns.description: Total number of successfully analyzed walking frames in recording.
columns.missing_value_behavior: Must be positive integer stored as float64.
